messages.text: I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed reduced motion for the cards and win banner. Both now respond to the system preference, including changes made while the game is open. Their existing animations remain in place when reduced motion is off.

Type checking, all 138 unit tests, and all 77 browser tests passed. The changed files pass formatting; the repository-wide formatting check reports issues in three unrelated files: `scripts/replay.test.ts`, `tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts`, and `tests/layout.e2e.test.ts`.
